first_line: Was on fortifiedroofing.com earlier and the 245 Google reviews plus the 0% financing offer on the Signature Fortified Roof really stand out.
Saw on hamiltonroofinginc.com that you've roofed for NASA and the Air Force, but I didn't spot any client testimonials on the homepage backing that up.
Was on saberroofing.com and liked the GAF Master Elite badge, though requesting an estimate means clicking away from the homepage to a separate page.
Was looking at calcomroofinginc.com and noticed the estimate request lives on a separate page rather than right on the homepage where Orange County visitors land.
Was on primetimeroofing.com earlier and the $2,000 off hail damage replacements with 0% financing is a strong offer to lead with for Parker homeowners.
Was on seamlessroofingllc.com and it's clear silicone roof restoration is your specialty, with a nine-state footprint that could each use its own landing page.
Was on coomerroofing.com and 70 years as a family roofer in Greenwood is a great story, though the homepage only shows one customer testimonial.
Saw the post on roofmanagementinc.com about joining with Latite Roofing, and noticed the homepage doesn't show any client testimonials yet to back up the new regional reach.
Noticed rapidcityroofer.com forwards over to weathertite.com, which is a nice setup, and the call or text option up top for Black Hills homeowners is handy.
Was on maxwellroofing.com and liked the MAXCare program, though blog posts like Commercial Roofing Terminology 101 show no dates, so recent news is hard to spot.
Was on rci-construction.com earlier and noticed the footer still says 2011, and there's no way to request an estimate right from the homepage.
Was on your site after irongateroofing.com forwarded me to ircroofingtx.com, and noticed there's no estimate form or customer reviews right on the homepage.
Was on 1stchoiceroofs.com and the luxury options like KasselWood steel and Westlake tile are a nice differentiator, though I noticed Commercial is spelled Commerical in the menu.
Was on smithandsonsroofing.com and it's impressive seeing a family roofer from 1988 expanding into Florida, Georgia, Oklahoma and Nebraska.
Was on interstateroofingllc.com and noticed the footer spells it Insterstate Roofing, and there's no way to request an estimate right from the homepage.
Was on trinityroofingconstruction.com and saw the last blog post was back in July 2025, about roof inspections before installing solar panels.
Was on spsroof.com earlier and liked how clearly you split out industrial, education, multi-family and residential work, but I didn't spot any client reviews on the homepage.
Was looking at slateroofs.com and the slate and copper work is great, though the phone number only shows up down in the footer.
Was on smithroof.com earlier and noticed the footer still says 2022, and a few sections and the FAQ answers still have the Lorem Ipsum placeholder text.
Was reading dbsroofing.com and the homepage still mentions a 75 year legacy, but since 1948 that's closer to 78 years now, which is worth showing off.
Was on your site and the Ludowici Crown Roofer slate and tile work is impressive, but I didn't see homeowner reviews or an estimate form up front.
Tried pulling up egreenroof.com earlier and it's showing a WordPress database error instead of your homepage, so visitors can't see your work right now.
Was on damschroderroofing.com and loved the Sandusky testimonial, though the photos next to the reviews are placeholder images and the Facebook feed is showing an error.
Was on triadroofing.com and saw the 24 hour emergency leak work, but the phone number is only in the footer and I didn't spot client reviews.
Was on hendersonroofing.net and really liked the Roofr instant estimate button, and had a couple ideas for getting you found more across Huntsville and Decatur.
Was on cwcroofing.com and liked the free inspection form and storm claim focus, but I didn't see any customer reviews on the homepage to back it up.
Was on fortifiedroofs.com and the roofing from $138 a month offer stood out, so I had a few ideas for turning more visitors into estimates.
Was on ecmalone.com and the roof replacement calculator is a smart touch, congrats on 50 years, and I had a couple ideas for getting it more traffic.
Was on bouldinroofing.com and liked the Care Club idea and the cedar shake work, though the free estimate button sends people off to a separate contact page.
Was on aspenroofing.com and the 0% financing from $175 a month is a strong hook, and I had a few ideas for getting more estimate requests.
Was on licitraroofing.com earlier and liked that you list all 27 towns you serve, though there's no blog or project posts helping those town pages rank.
Was on your site and noticed messingroofing.com now forwards to messing.com, where the footer still reads 2025 despite all those Peoria reviews.
Was on parsonsroof.com earlier and noticed the footer still says 2023, and inspection requests send people off to a separate page.
Checked out sharperoof.com and the GAF Master Elite and A+ BBB badges stand out, but your customer reviews live on a separate page instead of the homepage.
Was on sunriseroofs.com and liked the Google reviews up front, though Ponte Vedra homeowners have to click to a separate page to request a quote.
Was looking at pro-roofingsystems.com and noticed the homepage sends people to a contact page to talk, with no quick way to request a roof estimate right there.
Was on keithsternroofing.com and 40 years in Orange Park is impressive, but I couldn't find a way to request that free estimate right from the homepage.
Was on hertlessbrothers.com and loved the historic roofing work, but the phone number only shows in the footer and there's no homepage estimate form.
Was on beckroofing.com and noticed a paragraph about online casino free spins showing up in the middle of your homepage, which looks like something slipped in there.
Was on mrcva.com and liked the financing calculator, but noticed it says established 2010 alongside 25 years of experience, and the quote button jumps to another page.
Was on davidmartinandsonroofing.com and liked the 4.9-star reviews up front, though I didn't spot any mention of financing on the homepage.
Was on pondroofing.com and the multi-step quote form is really well done, though I didn't see specific Northern Virginia towns or a blog pulling in local searches.
Was on johntmorganroofing.com earlier and noticed the footer still says 2017, which undersells a company that's been roofing the Roanoke Valley since 1933.
Was on armormetalroofing.com and liked the Kennebunk and Portsmouth project write-ups, but noticed the footer still says 2023.
Checked out nobleroofteam.com and the Google reviews and estimate form are solid, and I had a couple ideas to help the Longview pages pull more leads.
Was on srsroofandmetal.com and the employee-owned, union crew story is great, but I didn't see any client testimonials or a quick project request form on the homepage.
Saw the July emergency roof repair post on atexroofing.com, so you clearly keep things current, and I had a few ideas to turn more visitors into inspections.
Was on kirtleyroofing.com and liked the testimonials, but noticed visitors have to click over to the contact page to request an estimate.
Was on wncroofing.com and liked the 4-hour response promise for commercial clients around Asheville and Upstate SC, though I didn't spot a blog or project section.
Was on barrelleroofing.com and liked the Georgia summer roof article, and had a few ideas to turn more of those blog readers into inspection requests.
Was on metalroofcontractors.com and noticed the footer still says 2017, and there's no way to request a standing seam quote right from the homepage.
Was on rsvlroofing.com and liked the Yelp testimonials, but the estimate request lives on a separate contact page instead of right on the homepage.
Was on boycesroofing.com earlier and noticed the footer still says 2024, and an old Thanksgiving closure notice is still posted on the homepage.
Was on takrause.com and noticed the COVID-19 safety notice is still up, and estimates are phone-only from the homepage with no request form.
Was on reviveroofingteam.com and liked the 5.0 Google rating up front, and had a few ideas to help the Loganville and Monroe pages bring in more inspections.
Was on apolloprimm.com and noticed there's no inspection request form or customer testimonials on the homepage, just the phone number up top.
Was on hightowerroofing.com and the 630+ reviews stand out, but the Google reviews section on the homepage is showing a Place ID not found error.
Was on edge2edgeroofing.com and the GAF Master Elite badge stands out, but I didn't see any customer reviews on the homepage to back it up.
Was on qualityroofing.com and liked that the blog is current, though the homepage doesn't show any customer reviews to back up your commercial membrane work.
Was on washingtonroofingcompany.com and it's great to see a roofer going since 1968, though the footer still says 2025 and estimates live on a separate page.
Was on cactusstateroofing.com and the Gilbert reviews look great, though the footer still says 2024 and I didn't see financing mentioned anywhere.
Was on premierroofingalaska.com and loved the Anchorage and Eagle River testimonials, and had a couple ideas to turn that trust into more estimate requests.
Was on myroofcare.com and noticed the most recent blog post I could find is from August 2022, while the rest of the site looks pretty current.
Was on landmarkroof.com and liked the recent composite clay tile guide, clearly a well kept site, so I had a couple ideas for pulling in more estimates.
Was on cmsrestore.com and liked seeing the 4.7 rating from 165 reviews right on the homepage, along with the Northeast Ohio and Sarasota locations.
Was on ibexroof.com and the 1,200+ reviews and financing callouts really stand out, though I noticed the footer still shows 2025.
Was on quality1roofing.com earlier and noticed the footer still says 2019, even though your blog just had a new post this month.
Was on heritageroofing.com and liked the Owens Corning Platinum Preferred badge, though I didn't see a way to request an estimate right from the homepage.
Was on pyramidcolorado.com and noticed the footer still says 2020, and there's no way to request a hail damage estimate right from the homepage.
